description: Ethereum EIP-1559 gas per recent block: base fee (gwei), gas used ratio, and priority fee (tip) percentiles at 10/50/90 from eth_feeHistory, plus the next block's base fee. Gas used by contract is not included (this RPC does not give it). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_ethereum_gas_telemetry
title: Crypto Ethereum Gas Telemetry
